summary: Iter 220ea·33 Legacy Import E2E — REGRESSION FIX VERIFIED. EngineerHomeV2 now mounts cleanly with Wand2/X imports in place; no EngineerErrorBoundary card. Full wizard flow works end-to-end: Step 1 customer gate (next-upload disabled until name) → Step 2 CSV upload → Gemini 3 extraction (3s) returned 2 machines → Step 3 review with expandable toggles + inline name edit → Step 4 legacy-step-done with view-pdf + done-another buttons. Dismissible tile persists hidden state via localStorage 'gx_engineer_legacy_tile_hidden'=1 across reload. ONE MEDIUM BUG FOUND: legacy-done-view-pdf renders but its href attribute is empty, so the PDF cannot be opened from the wizard. legacy-toggle-saved was not found on the done step (may only render before/after done — needs main-agent confirmation). Account Settings entry (engineer-settings-legacy-import-row) was inside the drawer that opens directly from menu-btn (no intermediate Settings link); did not get to scroll-test the row this run.

ui_bugs.issue: legacy-done-view-pdf <a> has empty href attribute — clicking it will not open the branded PDF in a new tab. PDF blob URL or backend GET path is not wired into the anchor.
legacy-toggle-saved not visible from the Done step in this run; verify it should be present on all steps (Customer / Done) per the spec.

issues: Cookie-consent banner (data-testid=cookie-consent-banner) overlays the bottom of the wizard and intercepts clicks on legacy-next-upload — required force=True in test. Consider raising wizard z-index or lowering banner once user has scrolled past the fold.

action_items: Wire legacy-done-view-pdf href to the saved report's PDF endpoint (URL.createObjectURL(blob) or backend GET path) so 'View PDF' actually opens the branded PDF in a new tab.
Confirm legacy-toggle-saved visibility rules — if it should appear on the Done step or Step 1, ensure it is mounted there (it was absent on Step 4 in this run).

Re-run a focused micro-test for the Account Settings → Tools → 'engineer-settings-legacy-import-row' once the above two are addressed; drawer opens directly from engineer-home-menu-btn (no intermediate link), the Tools section is below Customers in the same drawer.
critical_code_review_comments: Wand2/X regression has been correctly resolved (line 27 imports both). Consider re-enabling react/jsx-no-undef in ESLint (DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true is set in frontend/.env) so this class of crash is caught in CI rather than in QA.

legacy-done-view-pdf using an <a href> bound to a blob/URL means it must be set after the save response resolves — verify the save handler updates state synchronously before transitioning to Step 4 (currently step-done appears within 1s which suggests state may transition before href is populated).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — core wizard + regression fix verified; PDF link bug + saved-list visibility outstanding
